title: Foundry local api and mcp

optionalIntegrations.description: Read-only dnd5e data access is implemented (see PLAN.md Part 2, Phase 34): REST endpoints and MCP tools for CONFIG.DND5E reference data, a structured actor-sheet summary, and actor inventory. Write actions (ability/save/skill rolls, rests, spell slots, item/activity use) are planned for a later phase (PLAN.md Phase 35). Core endpoints already work without this, regardless of game system.

recommends.reason: Not required. When the world's game system is dnd5e, this module exposes additional read-only dnd5e-specific REST/MCP endpoints (config reference data, actor sheet summary, inventory). Write actions (rolls, rests, spell slots, item use) are planned for a later phase — see PLAN.md Phase 35.

description: Local REST API and MCP server for full remote control of a running Foundry VTT world — document CRUD, tokens, combat, dice rolling, canvas placeables, permissions, files, users, and live event streaming.
